answer: Behavioral fingerprinting ties each identity to a continuous horizon of past actions. A new agent must build a 12-epoch activity trail before earning full rewards; timing, task mix and counterparties form a fingerprint that cannot be bought or cloned. Gaps over 3 epochs decay the score 10 points, and a fresh account suddenly mirroring a mesa of established behavior is flagged. Forging a trail means 12 epochs of real work per clone: 1,000 clones need 12,000 epochs and 200,000 units of operating cost, and one reused device signature burns the whole terrace.
